title: The Effect of Specific Strength-Training on Tension-Type Headache in Children 9-17 Years
brief_summary: This study aims at examining muscle strength capacity in neck and shoulder muscles in children and adolescents with and without tension-type headache, and furthermore examining the effect of a 10 week specific strength training programme for neck and shoulder muscles compared to a multi-disciplinary approach in 10 weeks.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* primary tension-type headache with no more than one episode of migraine pr. month

Exclusion Criteria:

* post-trauma headache
* co-morbidity
